successCriteria.description: src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts no longer declares a local `AuthUser` interface; it imports `AuthUser` from `'../../shared/auth'` and the local declaration is removed.

The `EmployeeAuthRequest` alias and the `resolveActor` return type resolve to the shared `AuthUser` type (no type errors, no behavioral change), and `resolveActor` still returns `{ id, role }` and throws `UnauthorizedError` on missing/invalid user.

constraints: The change is a pure type swap: no runtime behavior, route registration, or error semantics may change. Only the local `AuthUser` declaration is removed and the shared type imported.
Keep the existing `EmployeeAuthRequest` alias unchanged (do not replace it with the shared `AuthedRequest` type).
Scope is limited to `src/modules/employee/employee.routes.ts`; do not modify `leave.routes.ts`, `balance.routes.ts`, or any other file.
outOfScope: Removing the local `AuthUser` declarations in `src/modules/leave/leave.routes.ts` and `src/modules/balance/balance.routes.ts`.
Any change to the shared `AuthUser` type in `src/shared/auth/index.ts` or to auth/route runtime behavior.

entityInvariants.invariant: There is exactly one canonical `AuthUser` type (in `src/shared/auth`); `employee.routes.ts` must reference it rather than redeclare a structurally identical local copy.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The imported `AuthUser` must be the one exported from `src/shared/auth/index.ts` (structurally `{ id: string; role: EmployeeRole }`), so the local declaration can be removed with no type drift.
`resolveActor` must continue to enforce the same boundary contract as the shared auth module: read `request.user`, throw `UnauthorizedError` when absent/invalid, and return `{ id, role }`.

integrationPoints.why: Source of the canonical `AuthUser` type that `employee.routes.ts` must import.
